messages:
Aisha (hw-partner): vendor check-in: can NVIDIA/AMD/Gaudi confirm driver/firmware signoff timeline? We have a public announcement window mid-April. Need hard dates by EOD Tue. @Marco :wave:
Marco (partnerships): NVIDIA asked for an embargo until Apr 15 in writing. AMD said MI300 should be safe by Apr 9. Gaudi team warned of a microcode candidate Apr 8 that may slip. If we wait for all, GA could slip. :thinking_face:
DevBot: CI alert: marketplace-image build 401 failed on MI300 smoke test. Log snippet: "kernel oops at 0xabcdef - module load failure". Full logs: https://ci.internal/401
Lena (sw-integrations): Re: DevBot - MI300 failure looks like a kernel module/version mismatch. I can reproduce locally with staging kernel. Need vendor kernel package to confirm. ETA re-run once we have it: ~48h. Suggest mitigation: tag MI300 as "beta-marketplace" and proceed with H100/H200 for initial GA if those pass.
Ravi (eng-release): we're baking H100 images now. If embargos hold, we can do NA first. Image QA is ~24h per SKU. We can parallelize but need vendor blobs.
Sam (product): Roadmap note: customers expect "April" from our public roadmap. If vendors push embargo past Apr 10 we need a clear fallback. Options: 1) public GA Apr 20 but limited SKUs (H100/H200), 2) soft GA Apr 12 with beta MI300/Gaudi, 3) delay full GA to Apr 25. Decision by Apr 10 to hit docs/marketing deadlines.
Marco (partnerships): Draft runbook suggestion:
- Apr 6: consolidate vendor embargo windows (owner: Aisha)
- Apr 7-9: SI + CI smoke runs (owner: Lena + Ravi)
- Apr 10: decision call: public GA vs stagger (owner: Marco)
- Apr 11-14: marketplace image push + docs freeze (owner: eng-release)
Aisha (hw-partner): I'll escalate with Gaudi to try to move microcode drop earlier. Also asking vendors for signed kernel blobs to avoid CI kernel mismatches.
Lena (sw-integrations): Aisha please drop vendor-provided kernel links here when available. I'll queue parallel test runners and tag results.
Sam (product): If we go staggered, marketing prefers a single message: "Initial GA: H100/H200; MI300/Gaudi available in early access". That keeps expectations tidy and avoids confusion in the marketplace listing.
Marco (partnerships): Quick check - react if you support staggered rollout (H100/H200 initial) :thumbsup:, react if you prefer holding the whole announcement :confused:
Aisha (hw-partner): :thumbsup:
Ravi (eng-release): :thumbsup:
Lena (sw-integrations): :thumbsup:
Sam (product): :thumbsup:
Marco (partnerships): Consensus looks like staggered. I'll draft an embargo-safe pre-announce for legal and partners. Scheduling a decision sync Apr 10 9:00am PT. Thanks all! :rocket:
